source_evidence.session_rules: Only exact local minute starts in 09:00..13:30 Asia/Taipei are normalized. Outside-session and malformed rows are counted; identical duplicates are counted. Conflicting duplicates, non-trading days and unsupported 13:31..13:39 closing shapes fail closed. Public dispatch uses the existing governed is_trading_day calendar; caller callable, closed_dates and holidays can add closures and cannot reopen governed closures. No new calendar or session tolerance is introduced.

Caller-supplied payload still accepted for replay.

source_evidence.adapter_registration: services/source_ingestion/provider_adapters.py: registered FinMindTaiwanKBarAdapter token + _finmind_kbar handler. This path is now in the canonical artifact contract. Required because ConnectorDefinition rejects adapter tokens missing from the provider allowlist (module import fails otherwise). source_evidence.unit_inference: measure_volume_unit reports sample_only and reconciliation_status=not_evaluated. The 15% tolerance selects a candidate factor only. It does not replace or widen SD section 5 daily volume <=2%, OHLC <=max(0.1%,1 tick), coverage >=95% and quarantine/no-imputation. Four stock-days on two stocks do not establish universal units.

review_fixes_20261112.complete_symbol_day: KBar fetch_config advertises 271 records (09:00..13:30 inclusive), and public dispatch without a fetch limit defaults to the same capacity. Both configured and caller caps are honored using their minimum. Nonpositive caps fail before the handler; positive caps below actual normalized symbol-day size raise SourceEvidenceError before the generic slice, emitting no partial day. Other adapters retain their prior limit behavior.
review_fixes_20261112.governed_calendar: provider_adapters._kbar_trading_day_gate delegates to existing services.execution.lean_runtime.instrument_candidates.is_trading_day. AND-composition preserves governed closures with a caller callable and unions both closed_dates and holidays; no calendar replacement or provider requests.
